## 💡 Acknowledgments & Heritage

**888GA** is an independent, customized fork of [RavelloH/InsightFlare](https://github.com/RavelloH/InsightFlare).

We extend our sincere gratitude to the original author **RavelloH** for the visionary serverless architecture and open source contribution!

### Key Enhancements in 888GA
- **Refined Typography Scale**: Eliminates tiny 10-11px blurred fonts in CJK environments, ensuring clean, legible text (13-16px).
- **Instant SPA Navigation**: Removed artificial 280ms transition delay and added preloading + memory caching for instant tab transitions.
- **Webmaster-First UX**: Quick 1-click HTML tracking snippet dialog and streamlined site management.
- **Traditional Chinese Localization**: Full zh-TW support across UI and alerts.
- **Streamlined Branding**: Clean **888GA** identity.
